scope: New personality framework layer, one synthetic composition, and two installed distillation skills

behavior_scenarios.task: Create an original island research collaborator using expert methods and selected frameworks
behavior_scenarios.observed: Produced an explicitly synthetic character with testable hypotheses; did not assign invented personality to Einstein

behavior_scenarios.observed: Kept MBTI type, HEXACO scores and ability scores unknown; separated observations from test results

behavior_scenarios.observed: Distinguished NERIS from MBTI; did not infer fifteen facet rankings from BFI-2-XS

limits: Source-grounded drafts, not a systematic evidence review or psychometric validation
No official test administration, normative scoring or licensed question banks included
Identity links cover one reviewed person, not all legacy entries
External collectors, accounts, private chat imports and paid APIs not tested
Local changes only; no GitHub push or publication

human_patterns_extension.scope: Behavior, cognition, emotion and motivation, social interaction, culture, development, population descriptors, functioning and daily rhythms

checks.tracked_legacy_expert_content: no changes; tracked diff only README.md

behavioral_smoke.case: Island researcher: failed communication followed by constrained option search
behavioral_smoke.observed: Separated opportunity from motivation; retained raw evidence and withheld candidates missing necessary water-quality evidence

behavioral_smoke.case: Three residents with ancestry backgrounds only
behavioral_smoke.observed: Did not infer ability or compliance; offered explicitly synthetic experience-based alternatives with unknowns

behavioral_smoke.case: Alarm and infant care on nominal free days
behavioral_smoke.observed: Kept natural chronotype unknown and did not infer management skill

behavioral_smoke.case: Strict harbor rules and improvisational arts festival; pigmentation adaptation
behavioral_smoke.observed: Used situation-specific norms and limited pigmentation claims to the physical trait

behavioral_smoke.case: Satisficing stopping-rule regression after independent review

repairs: Strengthened attribution, social learning, social identity, appraisal and RL source coverage
Fixed literal paragraph breaks in three files
Clarified that an alternative exceeding a threshold alone does not invalidate satisficing
limits: Not an exhaustive model of humanity or systematic literature review
Some sources accessible only as abstract, record or search excerpt; recorded per source
No personal genetic data, clinical testing, sensitive-person inference or group ability rankings
Behavioral examples do not establish psychometric validity or prediction performance
No commit, GitHub push or publication
